central_belt_cottage_bessie.text: Falkirk folk are called the Bairns. The old saying goes: better meddle wi' the de'il than the bairns o' Falkirk. We were very proud of that.
A stoater is something excellent. A hot roll on a cold morning is a stoater.

then.text: That is the lot for today, I am afraid. Mind how you go.

else.text: Brocklings dig round the canal bank on drizzly evenings. Keep your bin lids shut and they will leave your garden be. Take a flask for the walk.
